units: <cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 21:20">Targ. O. Deut. XXI, 20</cite>.—[<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 30:20">Targ. I Sam. XXX, 20</cite> <he>וסבא</he> some ed., read <he>ושְׁבָא</he>.].

senses.gloss: to retail wine in the shop or tavern.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 98a:9">B. Bath. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>אדעתא לסַבּוּיֵיה</he> with the intention to retail it.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10a:8">Keth. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>אַסְבּוּהוּ כופרי</he> make him absorb (strike him with) palm switches.
<cite ref="Ketubot 10a:9">Ib.</cite> <he>ומַסְבִּינָן ליה וכ׳</he> and we lash him nevertheless.
